protocol: 5-fold Murcko GroupKFold; each fold trains on the full outer-train set; no calibration
similarity: max Morgan radius-2 Tanimoto (2048 bits) to molecules in that fold's outer-training set
existing_ad_rule: 5th percentile of leave-one-out nearest-neighbour Tanimoto inside the 513 training molecules
why_threshold_excludes_clinical_candidat: The 0.567 line is the left tail of similarity among training-set analogues, not an estimate of where predictive performance collapses. A congeneric series still has a high 5th percentile. Clinical molecules sit near 0.2 because they are not members of that series. The threshold was not lowered.
